email.body1:
Darryl, saw Finovifi acquire Modern Banking Systems and roll out FrontLine Sentry for community banks.

Expanding into core banking usually puts more in-market institutions in play than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Finovifi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Darryl, quick follow-up for Finovifi.

With core banking now in the mix, the addressable base of community banks just grew faster than reps can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to work that wider base, so the gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Finovifi needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.

Darryl, last bit of proof for Finovifi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Finovifi's reply rate likely compares to other fintech firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Finovifi either way.
